catalog_scope: Complete WHO ICD-10 2010 K00-K14: 15 categories and 108 terminal codes; WHO classification, not ICD-10-CM. Original rubrics retained as reference text; coder must check parent notes and official index.

entries.official_title: Disorders of tooth development and eruption
Abnormalities of size and form of teeth
official_exclusions: tuberculum Carabelli, which is regarded as a normal variation and should not be coded
Hutchinson teeth and mulberry molars in congenital syphilis ( A50.5 )

entries.official_title: Hereditary disturbances in tooth structure, not elsewhere classified

official_inclusions: Premature: eruption of tooth; shedding of primary [deciduous] tooth

official_exclusions: embedded and impacted teeth with abnormal position of such teeth or adjacent teeth ( K07.3 )

official_notes: An embedded tooth is a tooth that has failed to erupt without obstruction by another tooth.
An impacted tooth is a tooth that has failed to erupt because of obstruction by another tooth.
